prose: The Financial Times reports that Dell, Jera and UK-based Rhaelm will build a $15 billion, 400-megawatt off-grid AI data center with its own gas power plant near Tokyo, due to start around 2028. It would be among Asia's largest such projects outside China. Based on the Techmeme excerpt; the FT article was paywalled.
highlights: $15B, 400MW off-grid AI data center near Tokyo
One of Asia's largest outside China
